interpretation_limits: Proxy recurrence is not confirmed action identity.
Candidate shares among matched windows differ from total-time dominance.
Block shuffles retain short within-block motifs; old composite rejection is not a proof that no recurrence exists.
Prediction MSE tests a different hypothesis from motif reuse; removing prediction alone still leaves old null failures.
Latent MSE is only comparable within one frozen representation.
Sparse/overlapping windows are not independent sessions.
